markdown-preview-enhanced.configPath.mar: Restart is required after changes. The global configuration directory path. Leave it empty to use `$HOME/.crossnote` for Windows or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/.crossnote` or `$HOME/.local/state/crossnote` as the config path.
markdown-preview-enhanced.markdownParser: Markdown parser/renderer to use. 'markdown-it' (default) is the built-in renderer. 'pandoc' uses Pandoc (requires Pandoc installed; not available in VS Code web). 'markdown_yo' uses a high-performance WASM renderer (or native binary when markdownYoBinaryPath is set; experimental).
Render via Pandoc. Requires Pandoc to be installed. Not available in VS Code web.
High-performance renderer (experimental). Uses WASM by default, or a native binary when markdownYoBinaryPath is set. markdown-it is still used for token-based operations.
markdown-preview-enhanced.breakOnSingleN: In Markdown, a single newline character doesn't cause a line break in the generated HTML. In GitHub Flavored Markdown, that is not true. Enable this config option to insert line breaks in rendered HTML for single newlines in Markdown source.
markdown-preview-enhanced.scrollSync.des: Automatic scroll sync. This is now partially supported.
markdown-preview-enhanced.liveUpdate.des: Re-render the preview as the contents of the source changes, without requiring the source buffer to be saved. If disabled, the preview is re-rendered only when the buffer is saved to disk.
markdown-preview-enhanced.liveUpdateDebo: Debounce time in milliseconds for live updates. Higher values reduce CPU usage but may feel less responsive. Lower values provide more immediate feedback but may impact performance.
markdown-preview-enhanced.previewMode.ma:
- **Single Preview**: Only one preview will be shown for all editors.
- **Multiple Previews**: Multiple previews will be shown. Each editor has its own preview.
- **Previews Only**: No editor will be shown. Only previews will be shown. You can use the in-preview editor to edit the markdown.

Restart is required after changes.
markdown-preview-enhanced.automaticallyS: Automatically show preview of markdown being edited.
markdown-preview-enhanced.disableAutoPre: A list of URI schemes (e.g., `vscode-notebook-cell`) to exclude from the `automaticallyShowPreviewOfMarkdownBeingEdited` feature. Files matching these schemes won't trigger the automatic preview.

A list of file name patterns (e.g., `*.note.md`) to exclude from the `automaticallyShowPreviewOfMarkdownBeingEdited` feature. Files whose names match any of these patterns won't trigger the automatic preview. Supports `*` as a wildcard. Matching is performed against the file's basename (not full path) and is case-insensitive.
markdown-preview-enhanced.previewColorSc: Follow system color scheme. If set to true, then the theme of markdown preview will automatically switch between light and dark when your system switch between light and dark. For example, if you set the current preview theme to `github-light.css`, then when your system is dark, the preview theme will be switched to `github-dark.css` automatically. If set to false, then the theme of markdown preview will not be changed automatically.

Use the same theme as the editor (light or dark). If set to true, then the theme of markdown preview will automatically switch between light and dark when you switch between vscode light and dark theme. For example, if you set the current preview theme to `github-light.css`, then when you switch to vscode dark theme, the preview theme will be switched to `github-dark.css` automatically. If set to false, then the theme of markdown preview will not be changed automatically.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableTypograp: Enable smartypants and other sweet transforms.
markdown-preview-enhanced.mathRenderingO: Choose the Math expression rendering method here. You can also disable math rendering if you want by choosing 'None'.
markdown-preview-enhanced.mathInlineDeli: Use customized Math expression inline delimiters.
markdown-preview-enhanced.mathBlockDelim: Use customized Math expression block delimiters.
markdown-preview-enhanced.mathRenderingO: Choose the Math expression rendering method option for GFM markdown export (Save as Markdown).
markdown-preview-enhanced.mathjaxScriptS: MathJax script source. Leave it empty to use the default CDN (MathJax v4).
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableWikiLink: Enable Wiki Link syntax support. More information can be found at https://help.github.com/articles/adding-links-to-wikis/
Enable or disable conversion of URL-like text to links in the markdown preview.
markdown-preview-enhanced.useGitHubStyle: If checked, we use GitHub style piped wiki links, i.e. [[linkText|wikiLink]]. Otherwise, we use [[wikiLink|linkText]] as the original Wikipedia style.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableEmojiSyn: Enable emoji & font-awesome plugin. This only works for markdown-it parser, but not pandoc parser.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableExtended: Enable extended table syntax to support merging table cells.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableCriticMa: Enable CriticMarkup syntax. Only works with markdown-it parser. Please check http://criticmarkup.com/users-guide.php for more information.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableTagSynta: Enable Obsidian-style #tag syntax. Renders `#tag-name` (and nested `#parent/child`) as clickable pill-shaped anchors. Click a tag to open VS Code's "Search in Files" pre-filled with the tag.
markdown-preview-enhanced.maxNoteFileSiz: Maximum size (in bytes) of a Markdown file that crossnote will load into the in-memory note index. Files larger than the cap are skipped during workspace refresh — they won't appear in autocomplete, backlinks, or the tag panel, but you can still open them via wikilink click. Prevents pathological cases where a checked-in log/data dump with a `.md` extension would otherwise pin its full content (plus a parsed token tree) in memory. Set to `0` to disable the cap.
markdown-preview-enhanced.wikiLinkTarget: The file extension for the link in wikilink if the link does not have an extension.
markdown-preview-enhanced.wikiLinkResolu:
How bare-filename wiki links (e.g. `[[Note]]`) are resolved to a file path.

- `relative` — resolve relative to the current note's directory (default).
- `shortest` — search all notes by filename, preferring the shortest unique path (with same-directory tiebreaking). Obsidian-style.
- `absolute` — resolve from the notebook/workspace root.

Links starting with `/` always resolve from the notebook root regardless of this setting.
Resolve relative to the current note's directory.
Search all notes by filename, preferring the shortest unique path.
markdown-preview-enhanced.wikiLinkTarget: The case for the file name in wikilink. If the value is `none`, then the file name will not be changed. Otherwise, the file name will be transformed to the specified case. You can read https://www.npmjs.com/package/case-anything for more details.
markdown-preview-enhanced.frontMatterRen: Render front matter as a table with one column per key
Render front matter as a table with one key and value per row
Render front matter as a code block
markdown-preview-enhanced.mermaidTheme.d: Mermaid theme, you can choose one from ["mermaid.css", "mermaid.dark.css", "mermaid.forest.css"]
markdown-preview-enhanced.codeBlockTheme: Code block theme. If `auto.css` is chosen, then the code block theme that best matches the current preview theme will be picked.
markdown-preview-enhanced.imageFolderPat: When using Image Helper to copy images, by default images will be copied to root image folder path '/assets'
You can choose different image uploader to upload image
markdown-preview-enhanced.printBackgroun: Whether to print background for file export or not. If set to `false`, then `github-light` preview theme will be used. You can also set `print_background` in front-matter for individual files.
markdown-preview-enhanced.chromePath.des: Chrome executable path, which is used for Puppeteer export. Leaving it empty means the path will be found automatically.
markdown-preview-enhanced.imageMagickPat: ImageMagick command line path. Should be either `magick` or `convert`. Leaving it empty means the path will be found automatically.
markdown-preview-enhanced.markdownYoBina: Path to the markdown_yo native binary. When set and markdownParser is 'markdown_yo', crossnote will use this binary (via stdin/stdout) instead of the bundled WASM module. The native binary is faster for files under ~300 KB; WASM is faster for very large files. Supports $HOME and ~ variable substitution. Leave empty to use WASM (default).
markdown-preview-enhanced.pandocMarkdown: The pandoc markdown flavor you want
markdown-preview-enhanced.pandocArgument: Args passed to pandoc command e.g. ["--smart", "--filter=/bin/exe"] Please use long argument names.
markdown-preview-enhanced.latexEngine.de: Default latex engine for Pandoc export and latex code chunk.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableScriptEx:
Enables executing code chunks and importing javascript files.
⚠️ Please use this feature with caution because it may put your security at risk! Your machine can get hacked if someone makes you open a markdown with malicious code while script execution is enabled.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enablePreviewS:
Enables user-provided preview scripts: `<script src>` tags in `.crossnote/head.html` and `@import "*.js"` file imports. Only files inside the workspace can be loaded — inline scripts and remote URLs are never executed.
⚠️ Please use this feature with caution: scripts run inside the preview webview, so a malicious repository could abuse whatever the preview has access to. This setting can only be changed in user settings and is ignored in untrusted workspaces.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableHTML5Emb: Enables transform audio video link to to html5 embed audio video tags.
markdown-preview-enhanced.HTML5EmbedIsAl: When true embed media with http:// schema in URLs. When false ignore and don't embed them.
markdown-preview-enhanced.HTML5EmbedAudi: HTML attributes to pass to audio tags.
markdown-preview-enhanced.HTML5EmbedVide: HTML attributes to pass to video tags.
markdown-preview-enhanced.puppeteerWaitF: Puppeteer waits for a certain timeout in milliseconds before the document export.
markdown-preview-enhanced.plantumlServer: Render using PlantUML server instead of binary. Leave it empty to use the builtin plantuml.jar binary (`java` is required in system path). Eg: "http://localhost:8080/svg/"
markdown-preview-enhanced.hideDefaultVSC: Hide the default VSCode markdown preview extension buttons. Restarting the editor is required to make this config take effect.
markdown-preview-enhanced.plantumlJarPat: Absolute path to the plantuml.jar file (`java` is required in system path). You can download it from https://plantuml.com/download.
markdown-preview-enhanced.krokiServer.de: The URL of the Kroki server to use.
markdown-preview-enhanced.webSequenceDia: The URL of the WebSequenceDiagrams server to use for rendering wsd code blocks.
API key for WebSequenceDiagrams. Required for wider diagram sizes.
markdown-preview-enhanced.d2Path.descrip: Path to the D2 executable. Defaults to `d2` (i.e. found on PATH). Not supported in the web extension.
markdown-preview-enhanced.d2Layout.descr: Default D2 layout engine for rendering d2 diagrams.
markdown-preview-enhanced.d2Theme.descri: Default D2 theme for rendering d2 diagrams.
markdown-preview-enhanced.d2Sketch.descr: Render D2 diagrams in sketch (hand-drawn) style.
markdown-preview-enhanced.markdownFileEx: Markdown file extensions. This is used to determine whether to show the preview button in the markdown file context menu.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enablePreviewZ: Enable this option will hide unnecessary UI elements in preview unless your mouse is over it.
markdown-preview-enhanced.useVSCodeTheme: When enabled, the context menu in preview inherits VS Code's theme colors and font instead of the default styling.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enablePreviewC: Show the extension's custom right-click menu in the preview. Disable it to fall back to the browser's native context menu, with its usual Copy/Paste entries.
markdown-preview-enhanced.enableImageLig: Click an image in the preview to view it in a full-screen lightbox overlay. Press Escape or click the backdrop to close.
markdown-preview-enhanced.aiTranslationP: AI provider id for the Translate feature, e.g. "openai", "anthropic", "minimax-cn", "deepseek". See @earendil-works/pi-ai provider list.
markdown-preview-enhanced.aiTranslationM: Model id for AI translation, e.g. "gpt-4o-mini". Must be a valid model for the chosen provider.
markdown-preview-enhanced.aiTranslationA: When the preview is in translation mode, automatically re-translate changed blocks after you stop typing for 3 seconds. Disabled by default to avoid unattended API usage.
markdown-preview-enhanced.setAiTranslati: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Set AI Translation API Key
markdown-preview-enhanced.translateNow.t: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Translate Current Preview
markdown-preview-enhanced.showOriginalTr: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Show Original Translation
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudEnabl: Master switch for the read-aloud feature (local Kokoro server): play buttons, click to read, selection reading and the player bar in the preview.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudClick: Start reading with a plain click in a readable block of the preview: playback begins at the nearest word and continues to the end of the document (a table cell is read to the end of the cell, then stops). Playable text shows a pointer cursor while this is on. A click on a word whose audio is already synthesised jumps the audio instead of requesting it again. Drags, double clicks, modified clicks, links and checkboxes are unaffected.
markdown-preview-enhanced.kokoroVoice.de: Kokoro voice id used for read aloud, e.g. af_heart (American English, female) or bm_george (British English, male). Blend voices with +, e.g. af_bella+af_sky. Run "Choose Read Aloud Voice" to pick from the server's list.
Base URL of the Kokoro-FastAPI server. Plain http is accepted on localhost only; any other host must be https.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudSpeed: Playback rate for read aloud (0.25–4). Applied with HTMLMediaElement.playbackRate; nothing is re-synthesized.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudVolum: Output volume for read aloud (0–1), set from the volume control on the player panel in the preview.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHighl: Colour theme for the read-aloud highlight: the rounded pills behind each line of the block being read and the box on the spoken word. The light or dark variant is chosen automatically from the preview theme's background. Also set from the theme settings of the player panel in the preview.
Font family for the preview, overriding the preview theme's own. Only families a machine already has are offered, and each is a stack that degrades to a generic family where the first choice is missing; code, diagrams and maths keep their own font. Also set from the theme settings of the player panel in the preview.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudGloba: The low-strain reading page: a light or dark theme with measured contrast, the Atkinson Hyperlegible Next face, 20 px text and a 66-character column, in place of the preview theme. `auto` follows the VS Code colour theme; `light` and `dark` force one; `off` restores the preview theme selected in `previewTheme`. Also set from the theme settings of the player panel. Applies to the live preview only, never to exports.
Follow the VS Code colour theme (default).
The light page, whatever VS Code looks like.
The dark page, whatever VS Code looks like.
Off: the preview theme decides, exactly as before the page existed.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudTextS: Text size of the low-strain page, in pixels (16–28). The line height, the width of the reading column (66 characters) and the heading sizes follow from it. Also set from the theme settings of the player panel. No effect while `readAloudGlobalTheme` is `off`.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudWordM: How the spoken word is marked: an underline in the highlight theme's colour (the glyphs keep their brightness), a filled box, or nothing. The pills behind the block being read are unchanged. Also set from the theme settings of the player panel.
An underline sweep in the highlight theme's stroke colour (default).
A filled box, the reader-app look.
No word marker; the pills alone say where the reading is.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudDimWh: While a read is playing, dim the text of every other paragraph of the low-strain page, the next one less than the rest, so the block being read stands out. Code, tables, maths and images are never dimmed. No effect while `readAloudGlobalTheme` is `off`.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudPanel: Fade the player panel out after a few seconds of playback without mouse or keyboard activity, leaving a thin progress line at the bottom of the preview. Any activity, a pause or an error brings it back.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudCache: Size cap in MB for the on-disk read-aloud audio cache (least recently used entries are evicted).
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHelpE: Which headless command writes the read-aloud help explanation. The passage and its context are sent to it on stdin; nothing is sent unless you press the help button, Alt+H, a follow-up chip or Ask.
claude -p (default). Uses whatever login the Claude Code CLI already has.
codex exec -. Uses whatever login the Codex CLI already has.
The command in readAloudHelpCommand: argv, prompt on stdin, answer on stdout.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHelpC: Model for claude --model. fable, opus, sonnet and haiku are the CLI's own aliases and always mean its latest model of that name; a full id such as claude-fable-5 pins one.
Use fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full claude-… model id.
Effort for claude --effort. low answers in a few seconds; high and above think for longer and cost more per answer, and the listener is waiting with a read paused.
Model for codex -m. Empty omits the flag, so the CLI's configured default answers.
Reasoning effort for codex (-c model_reasoning_effort). default omits the override. Not every model accepts every level; a refused level is shown as the CLI's own error.
Command for readAloudHelpEngine = custom, as an argv array (never a shell string). The prompt arrives on stdin and the answer is read from stdout. Element 0 may be an absolute path.
How much of the document is sent with the selected passage when you ask for help.
The passage, the block it was taken from, the document title and the heading breadcrumb only. The least text leaves the machine, and the weakest explanation.
Also the blocks either side of the passage, the rest of its section (capped at 6000 characters) and, for a selection of five words or fewer, the document's other mentions of those words (default).
The whole markdown source, capped at 60000 characters; falls back to section above that. Slow, and best on a short document whose whole argument matters.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHelpA: Who the explanation is written for. Goes into the prompt verbatim, e.g. "a backend engineer new to GitHub Actions".
Read the explanation aloud as soon as it arrives, as a read bounded to the help sheet.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHelpT: How long to wait for the help command before killing it (15–300 seconds).
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloudHelpB: Absolute paths to the claude and codex binaries, skipping the PATH and login-shell lookup. Machine scope: a workspace must not be able to point the feature at another binary.

markdown-preview-enhanced.notesEnabled.d: Reader notes: the Note button on the selection cluster (Alt+N), the markers in the right margin and the dotted mark under noted words, the Notes button on the player panel (Alt+Shift+N), the Note and Notes sheets, and the Notes view in the Explorer. Needs readAloudEnabled, whose preview layer hosts all of it. Desktop only.
markdown-preview-enhanced.notesDirectory: Where note files are written: an absolute path (`~` allowed); empty means the `notes` folder under the extension's global config directory (`~/.crossnote/notes`, or `~/.local/state/crossnote/notes` on Linux). Notes copy document text outside the repository — the passage, the block it sits in, the blocks before and after it and the heading path — into files here; a root inside a synced folder syncs that text. Machine scope: a workspace cannot redirect where document text is written.
Ask the help engine for a title, summary, why it matters, terms and tags as soon as a note is saved. Off: the passage and its context are saved and nothing is sent; Regenerate in the Note sheet still runs the engine on demand.
markdown-preview-enhanced.notesDecoratio: What the preview shows for a saved note.
A marker in the right margin of the block and a thin dotted mark under the noted words (default).
Nothing in the document; notes are reached from the Notes button and the Notes view.
markdown-preview-enhanced.notes.create.t: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Save a Note (Read Aloud)
markdown-preview-enhanced.notes.showList: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Notes in This Document

markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomEnabl: Classroom: the Classroom button on the selection cluster (Alt+C) and Teach me this on the Help sheet, which have an instructor persona write a short teaching module about the selected passage as a markdown file that opens beside the document; the Module sheet in a module's own preview (Alt+Shift+C). Needs readAloudEnabled. Desktop only.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomDirec: Where classroom modules and user personas are written: an absolute path (`~` allowed); empty means the `classroom` folder under the extension's global config directory (`~/.crossnote/classroom`, or `~/.local/state/crossnote/classroom` on Linux). Modules copy document text outside the repository: the passage, and everything the instructor wrote from the document, go into a file here; a root inside a synced folder syncs that text, and a confidential document's modules belong in a root that does not. Machine scope: a workspace cannot redirect where document text is written.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomPerso: The instructor persona in force: the id of a built-in persona (`max`) or of a folder under `<classroom root>/personas/<id>/` holding a `persona.md`. Written when the Classroom sheet's Instructor select is changed at Build.
A persona id is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 40 characters.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomAudie: Who the module is written for. Empty means the persona's own default audience. Written when the Classroom sheet's Audience field is changed at Build.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomFollo: Find the document's links to other markdown files in the workspace and offer them as extra material for the module (up to four, each capped at 30,000 characters). The sheet names every file before Build and each can be unticked; off finds none and sends none.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomAutoO: In multi-preview mode, open the module's preview beside the document as soon as its first chapter is written. Off shows an Open button on the sheet instead. In single-preview mode the panel is never retargeted on its own.
markdown-preview-enhanced.readAloud.clas: Markdown Preview Enhanced: This Classroom Module
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroom.open: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Open Classroom Module
Markdown Preview Enhanced: Open Classroom Folder
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroom.cont: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Continue Classroom Module
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroom.canc: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Cancel Classroom Build
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroom.dele: Markdown Preview Enhanced: Delete Classroom Module
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomShort: A selection of five words or fewer (a term) gets a smaller module: two chapters at the first lever row, four at the second, with lighter word targets; the third row is unchanged. The size line under the lever says what a row buys. Off: every selection takes the row's full budget.
markdown-preview-enhanced.classroomMarke: Show a marker in the right margin of the paragraph a classroom module was built from, in the source document. It opens the module (or the Classroom sheet when the paragraph has several) and follows the passage through edits like a note's marker. Off: no markers; the Classroom sheet's rows and the Open Classroom Module quick pick still list every module.
Retell: the Retell button on the selection cluster (Alt+T) and Retell the section on the Help sheet, which have the help engine write a spoken edition of the section the selection sits in (the same content, in the same order, under the same headings, with every table said as sentences, every code block said as what the code does and every identifier said as a spoken name) as a markdown file that opens beside the document; the Edition sheet in an edition's own preview (Alt+Shift+T); Retell Document for Listening. Sends the section, or every section of the document, to the engine on Build only. Needs readAloudEnabled. Desktop only.
markdown-preview-enhanced.retellDirector: Where spoken editions are written: an absolute path (`~` allowed); empty means the `retell` folder under the extension's global config directory (`~/.crossnote/retell`, or `~/.local/state/crossnote/retell` on Linux). Editions copy document text outside the repository: the retold text of every section goes into a file here; a root inside a synced folder syncs that text, and a confidential document's editions belong in a root that does not. Machine scope: a workspace cannot redirect where document text is written.
markdown-preview-enhanced.retellAutoOpen: In multi-preview mode, open the spoken edition's preview beside the document as soon as its first section is written. Off shows an Open button on the sheet instead. In single-preview mode the panel is never retargeted on its own.
markdown-preview-enhanced.retellMarker.d: Show an ear marker in the right margin of the heading a spoken edition was built from, in the source document, stacked under the note and classroom markers. It opens the edition (or the Retell sheet when the heading has several). Off: no markers; the Retell sheet's rows and the Open Spoken Edition quick pick still list every edition.
